title: Zero-Shot Formal Proof Synthesis using LLM Reflection and AST Verification
summary: Generating verifiable mathematical proofs requires strict adherence to formal logic. We design a closed-loop proof synthesis framework combining LLM reflection with abstract syntax tree (AST) execution checkers. In benchmark evaluations on MiniF2F, our iterative reflection loop raises proof generation pass rates from 32.1% to 68.7% by automatically catching syntax and type errors within 3 iterations.
